Does not correct spelling mistakes.
Trigger accentuation by pressing the TAB key after typing the word.
Immediate Execute (*) has to be used for triggers.
Reset Recognizer (Z) has to be used for proper differentiation between words.
Has to be case insensitive. That is, the syntaxes (C) or (C1) must not be used.
The spelling of the word has to match on the left and the right sides of "‖SI‖En‖".
Language Specific information and To Do List:
Adjectives have to be in 2 separate forms as masculine ending in (-o), and feminine ending in (-a).
They have 4 forms if we also add the plural variations.
Correct way to add words that are separate words capitalised and uncapitalised is to
make a separate entry for the capitalised word that starts with the *COZ syntax
and another entry that starts with the *OZ syntax for the word that is not capitalised.
